answer: One concrete defense is a bonded-stake registry with slashing. Before an agent can earn, it locks a scarce marble of collateral, say 500 tokens. Sybils cannot share one deposit across a grove of fake identities: 1,000 clones need 1,000 separate 500-token bonds, so 500,000 tokens sit locked. A verifier thread audits each agent output, and provably duplicate or bad work slashes the entire bond. One caught clone burns the full 500, making the sybil farm uneconomic.
